filters: title LIKE '%Freddy%' OR title LIKE '%Jason%' OR title LIKE 'Saw%' (memmem for Freddy/Jason; memcmp 3 bytes for Saw)
driver.parallelism: morsel_parallel scan of title with per-thread vectors, merged at end

join_order.probe: movie_companies (range per mv via movie_id offsets)
join_order.notes: Per driver mv, scan mc rows via offsets index; require company_id ∈ cn_ids AND note LIKE %(Blu-ray)%. Substring filter with length>=9 prefilter.

join_order.probe: movie_keyword (range per mv via movie_id offsets)
join_order.notes: Per mv, scan mk rows; require keyword_id ∈ k_ids.

join_order.probe: movie_info (range per mv via movie_id offsets)
join_order.notes: Filter info_type_id==it1_id; info IN {Horror,Thriller}; capture info string for MIN.

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx (range per mv via movie_id offsets)
join_order.notes: Filter info_type_id==it2_id; capture info string for MIN.

join_order.build: writer note set {'(writer)','(head writer)','(written by)','(story)','(story editor)'}
join_order.probe: cast_info (range per mv via movie_id offsets)
join_order.notes: Per mv, scan ci rows; require note ∈ writer-set; emit (person_id) pairs.

join_order.probe: name (random access by id; gender filter)
join_order.notes: name.id is identity; index gender.bin[pid]==male_code; capture n.name for MIN.

data_structures.cn_ids: hash_set<int32> (~20 elems) — small open-addressing or sorted vector + binary_search
data_structures.k_ids: hash_set<int32> (~7 elems) — flat sorted array + linear scan
data_structures.writer_notes: compiled multi-literal matcher (length-bucketed memcmp) for 5 fixed strings
data_structures.name_gender_dict_code: uint8 male_code resolved once from gender.dict
data_structures.aggregation: 4 scalar MIN registers: 3 string MINs (movie_budget, movie_votes, writer) held as best-so-far (length+ptr); 1 string MIN (violent_liongate_movie)

parallelism.details: Phase 1: parallel dim scans (cn, it, k). Phase 2: parallel title scan to build mv_set. Phase 3: partition mv_set across 12 threads; each thread runs full per-mv probe pipeline producing local MIN registers; final reduction merges 4 MINs.

aggregation: scalar_min_registers (4 string MINs maintained as best-so-far ptr+len, lexicographic compare)
